visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black tank top stands outside the Ming Yue Gong temple entrance with a woman whose face is obscured by a stylized anime girl sticker. They are gesturing towards the temple sign while talking. The background shows a paved temple forecourt under bright daylight. (2) Inside the temple, the man points at a large informational sign titled 'Five Great Relationships' on the wall. The lighting is bright and even. The man has a focused expression, and the woman stands beside him, listening and reacting with hand gestures. (3) The man holds a bundle of red incense sticks and hands some to the woman. They are standing near a prayer area with golden pillars and red decorative elements. A child in a white dress is seen wandering near them in the background. (4) The couple bows deeply in prayer before a large, ornate statue of Yue Lao, the marriage deity. The statue is reddish-gold and positioned on a high altar. The child stands between them, also looking at the altar. Other visitors are visible in the background. (5) The man interviews a woman in a grey shirt and jeans inside the temple. Later, he talks to a man wearing a black shirt and a face mask. They are in a spacious hall with informational displays and red tables. (6) The man, the woman with the filter, and another young woman sit at a red table, each holding and eating a popsicle. They are smiling and talking directly to the camera. Behind them is a large 'Matchmaking' sign.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male vocal greeting in Mandarin with a bright, professional tone. An upbeat, medium-tempo acoustic guitar melody serves as the BGM. There are subtle indoor room tone reverberations. A 'pop' SFX accompanies a visual text appearance. (2) A female voice enters, speaking with a curious and slightly teasing inflection. The male voice responds with a playful, high-arousal tone and audible laughter. A bubbly cartoon sound effect is used to emphasize a comedic moment. The guitar BGM continues steadily. (3) The man provides narrative information about 'audience luck.' His speech rate is fast and clear, with minimal pauses. The BGM remains in the background at a moderate volume. The acoustic texture is clean with high signal-to-noise ratio. (4) A slight shift in ambient noise as they move deeper into the temple hall. The BGM dips slightly in volume. The man's voice lowers in pitch and intensity during the prayer sequence, creating a more respectful and calm atmosphere. (5) Voices of different visitors are heard during interviews; they exhibit neutral arousal and conversational loudness. There is a 'ding' SFX as a specific point is made. The guitar BGM maintains a consistent rhythmic pulse. (6) The final phase features a group of voices speaking excitedly. The crunching sound of eating a popsicle is momentarily audible over the BGM. The video ends with a synchronized call to action from multiple speakers and a final musical flourish.

It uses humor and personal interaction to engage viewers.
